topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking down the hallway of the school, the posters on the walls are the same as they were when I was a student. Mr. Johnson's classroom door is open, and as I peer inside, there he is, standing next to posters about the solar system and the life cycle of a butterfly, just like in my old memories. My child, smiling, shares a joke with him. The thought swirls in my head, wondering if time is a circle or if this is just how stories loop, connecting us in unexpected ways. I clear my throat, stepping forward with a polite smile. "Hi, Mr. Johnson," I say, feeling the weight of old days and new beginnings in a single moment.
